note: The derivative limit is `bend_limit`; the rotation limit is for the transported Y_K divided by xi_k with the constant kappa instead of L_d(K), and holds for any scaling with `Track` beyond thresholds rather than along one stable sequence.

snippet.text:
lemma bend_limit (H : S.Hierarchy) (h : W.Derivatives S) (L : (Bel C.book).Hierarchy) (hp : V.Derivatives (Bel C.book))
    (X : Scaling S) (d : ℕ) (a : Axis) (ht : Approaches (path X) (isoPanel X)) :
    Tendsto (fun k => tiltScale X W k d a) atTop (𝓝 (leaves V.deriv d a)) := by

proof_context.conclusion: `bend_limit` says `tiltScale X W k d a`, which is `X.r k •` the carry of the derivative, tends to `leaves V.deriv d a` for scalings with `Approaches`.

Watches J R.T H.spin R.hT.spin V (fun X => (ConLap X p d ((R.T.κ:ℝ) • R.T.W.deriv) (fun i => X.r i/X.xi i)) ∧
      ∀ j : Spin.Ind, Tendsto (fun i => (X.xi i)⁻¹ • (Spin.transport Y (X.U i d) j)) atTop (𝓝 (R.T.κ • Spin.leaf R.T.K.lie d j)))

proof_context.conclusion: Under `Track` beyond thresholds, `(X.xi i)⁻¹ • Spin.transport Y (X.U i d) j` tends to `κ • Spin.leaf R.T.K.lie d j` for every generator j.
